findings.current: Get your asses over here and save your comrades.
findings.defect: The Korean explicitly tells the healers to hurry over at a run; the translation preserves the destination and task but drops the running action.
findings.rationale: The source says 존나게 뛰어와서, explicitly emphasizing running over quickly.
findings.replacement: Run your asses over here and save your comrades.

findings.current: I looked at their disbelieving faces and let out a laugh.
findings.defect: The translation reduces a hearty, full-throated laugh to an unspecified laugh.
findings.rationale: The source uses 너털웃음을 터트렸다, describing a hearty laugh breaking out.
findings.replacement: I looked at their disbelieving faces and burst into a hearty laugh.

summary: The translation is largely faithful. Two minor details are weakened: the urgency of running to the injured and the hearty quality of the narrator’s laugh.
